pack.name: Cinematic B-Roll Motion
pack.target_tools: Google Flow / Veo 3 (primary, best at slow deliberate camera moves), Runway Gen-4 (image-to-video from an approved Midjourney or Flux still), Kling 2.0 (best at vehicles and water), Sora. For anything with a car or a face, generate the still first and drive image-to-video.
pack.pack_notes:
Nine b-roll motion clips. All play muted and looped on the site, so all of them must loop or at least end on a frame close enough to the first that the jump is invisible. All are single continuous takes — no cuts, no montage, no scene changes.
VLN-VID-02 is special: it is the full-bleed background of the ENGINE section (#engine), which carries body copy on top of it. It must be dark, abstract, low contrast, and must contain NO literal charts, no candlesticks, no ticker text, no numbers, no dashboards, no screens with readable UI. It is a feeling of computation, not a picture of trading.
VLN-VID-03 through VLN-VID-10 are free-standing atmosphere clips for section transitions, social cutdowns, and any future slots. No on-screen text in any of them.
Every person who appears is non-identifiable: back to camera, masked, half-lit into shadow, cropped, or out of focus.

asset.title: The Engine — abstract data-room background
asset.placement: Full-bleed background of the ENGINE section (#engine). Body copy sits on top — keep it dark, low-contrast and abstract. Must loop.
asset.prompt: A single continuous, extremely slow lateral dolly past a wall of dormant black server hardware in an unlit machine room, shot at macro distance with a long lens so the racks dissolve into pure abstraction. Almost nothing is in focus: a shallow plane catches one row of tiny warm aged-gold indicator lights that pulse and travel in irregular, breathing sequences down the rack, while the rest of the frame is soft black metal and out-of-focus gold points floating as oval bokeh. Faint reflected gold light crawls along a brushed dark surface in the foreground. Thin volumetric haze hangs in the air and drifts. No screens, no monitors, no interfaces, no numbers, no letters, no charts, no graphs, no ticker, no dashboards — only light, metal and darkness. Very low contrast overall, everything sitting in the lower half of the exposure range so it reads as texture rather than subject. The camera tracks left to right at a constant crawl, no shake, no cut. Shot on 35mm anamorphic, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative; T2.0, extremely shallow depth of field, oval bokeh; deep crushed blacks, volumetric haze, subtle halation on the small gold highlights; desaturated near-monochrome palette of void black #050505 and aged gold #C8A96A; heavy negative space; fine organic film grain, print-film color science; abstract, cold, patient, expensive. First and last frames match for a seamless loop. No on-screen text, no titles, no audio narration.

asset.title: Velocity, Night — exotic cars in a wet street
asset.placement: Section transition, social cutdown, ambient loop.
asset.prompt: A single continuous slow dolly-in, low to the ground, along the flank of a matte-black wide-body supercar parked on wet cobblestones in an empty European side street at two in the morning. The only light is one warm aged-gold sodium lamp far up the street and a second reflected off a wet shopfront, so the car reads mostly as a black silhouette with a single long specular highlight running the length of its shoulder line and pooling in the wheel arch. Rain has stopped; water still beads on the paint and the street mirrors the lamp as a broken gold column. A thin ground mist drifts across the cobbles. The car's tail lights glow a dull oxblood, barely on. No badges, no visible logos, no number plate. No people, or at most a single Black man in a full-length black overcoat walking away into the dark at the far end of the street, back to camera, out of focus. The camera glides forward at a constant crawl, no shake, no cut. Shot on 35mm anamorphic, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative pushed one stop; T2.0, shallow depth of field, oval bokeh; single warm practical light source, deep crushed blacks with retained shadow detail, subtle halation on highlights; desaturated near-monochrome palette of void black #050505 and aged gold #C8A96A with a trace of oxblood #3B1B1B; heavy negative space, level horizon; fine organic film grain, print-film color science; cinematic, restrained, expensive, quietly menacing. No on-screen text, no titles, no audio narration. The people in frame are Black. Key their skin about one stop hotter than the room and add soft fill on the shadow side so it holds detail instead of going to pure black; let the specular sheen on skin roll rather than clip, and keep warmth in the midtones — the room stays crushed, the person does not.

asset.title: Villa Pool, After — night water
asset.placement: Closing / passport beat. The best natural loop in the pack.
asset.prompt: A single continuous locked-off shot of a long infinity pool at a cliffside villa, well after midnight, everyone gone. The water is black and almost still, moving only in slow shallow ripples. One warm aged-gold underwater light burns at the far end, throwing a shifting caustic web across the pool floor and a soft glow up onto the stone coping and a single row of bone-white loungers. Two abandoned glasses sit at the pool edge, one tipped on its side; a black dinner jacket is draped over the back of a chair. Beyond the infinity edge the sea and sky merge into one unbroken black, with three tiny distant lights on the horizon. Thin mist rises off the warm water. No people at all. Nothing moves but the water, the caustics and the mist. The camera does not move.
